protocol.status: Post-hoc hypothesis following failed macro and RSI2 results; entirely reused years, no independent validation
protocol.reason: RSI70 recovery had high win rate but inadequate payoff. Diagnose exit behavior with three fixed exits, not entry or RSI-length optimization. One separately fixed 4h 55/20 channel tests an intermediate price scale between the failed fast 4h and slow daily designs.
protocol.budget: Exactly four follow-ups, every outcome published, no additional presets or revised gates in this experiment

candidates.name: daily_rsi90_exit
candidates.exit: RSI2 above 90 for long, below 10 for short; otherwise initial stop or ten-day timeout

candidates.name: daily_sma5_exit
candidates.exit: Daily close above SMA5 for long, below SMA5 for short; otherwise initial stop or ten-day timeout

candidates.name: daily_three_day_exit
candidates.exit: Next open after three full days; otherwise initial stop

candidates.name: channel_4h_55_20
candidates.entry: 4h close beyond previous 55 highs/lows, next open

protocol.reversion_rules_unchanged: Daily EMA200 direction, RSI2 below10 long/above90 short, 2ATR14 stop, market next open, no pyramiding
protocol.execution_unchanged: 0.25% risk, 95% equity notional cap, max1BTC, .001 quantity step, .07% fee per side, two tick directional slippage, .25 ATR gap sizing reserve; actual funding and 5m traded-open mark proxy
protocol.selection: Among candidates passing every gate, choose highest minimum period net/drawdown; do not compare summed separate-account net as one portfolio
protocol.publication: A passing candidate is eligible only for an experimental Pine prototype. Native Bitunix/TradingView and prospective verification remain unfulfilled. If none passes, do not label a losing or less profitable script an upgrade.
